lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs posterior to the pectoral fin arranged in a semi-regular staggered grid, with approximately 12 primary centroids visible in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows to form rectangular anchor nodes, most prominent on the upper half of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp vertical gradient from light upper edges to dark shadowed lower edges.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition from large, sparse blobs on the lateral flank to a high-density cluster of significantly smaller, low-diameter spots on the anterior head region.
